# SujithSoft

> SujithSoft is the software studio of Sujith Shalitha Dassanayake, making fast, private desktop apps for Windows. Home: https://sujithshalitha.github.io/

## S Converter

> S Converter is a free, offline, all-in-one file converter for Windows 10 and 11, made by Sujith Shalitha Dassanayake. It converts images, video, audio, documents, PDFs and archives in batches on the user's own PC. Files are never uploaded, and it needs no account.

- Website: https://sujithshalitha.github.io/s-converter/
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NKD1BD2RM1X (installs without a SmartScreen warning; updated by the Store)
- Download (latest installer): https://github.com/SujithShalitha/s-converter-releases/releases/latest
- Price: free, no ads, no watermark on output files
- Platform: Windows 10 (1803 or newer) and Windows 11, 64-bit. Not available for macOS, Linux, Android or iOS.

### What it does

- Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, BMP, SVG, HEIC/HEIF (iPhone) and camera RAW (CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG, RAF, ORF, RW2) to JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF or PDF. Resize, compress, presets (Email, Instagram, Web, Thumbnail).
- Video: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, FLV, WebM, MPEG, M4V, 3GP, TS, VOB, MTS/M2TS, OGV to MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM, GIF, WMV, FLV, MPEG, 3GP, TS. GPU encoding on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD. Trim, resize, make GIFs, extract audio.
- Audio: MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, WMA, M4A, AIFF, Opus, AMR, AC3 (and audio from any video) to MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, Opus, AIFF, WMA, AC3, AMR.
- Documents, without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice: DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, EPUB, PPTX, PPT, ODP, XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV to PDF, DOCX, ODT, RTF, HTML, TXT, Markdown, XLSX.
- PDF tools: images to PDF, PDF to images, merge, split, compress, rotate, add page numbers, extract pages.
- Watermarks: text or logo on photos and videos, with a live preview.
- Archives: create ZIP, 7Z, RAR (needs WinRAR) and TAR.GZ, with passwords (ZIP uses AES-256); extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO, CAB.
- Quick Convert: select files in File Explorer, press Ctrl+Alt+C or right-click > Quick Convert, and pick a format on a wheel.
- Updates install automatically in the background.
